description_for_human: UK address, email, and phone validation. Direct Royal Mail PAF.
description_for_model: Postio is a UK validation API. Use it to: (1) search UK addresses by free-form text and resolve to a Royal Mail UDPRN; (2) look up every PAF delivery point at a UK postcode; (3) fetch the full address record for a UDPRN; (4) validate an email address (syntax, typo correction, MX, SMTP probe, disposable / role / free-provider classification, aggregate deliverability verdict); (5) validate a phone number with libphonenumber and run a live HLR lookup for current carrier, original carrier, ported flag, reachability. UK-only. Authentication is `x-api-key: <pk_*>` on every request.
